maya: Heads up — after merging the rope_theta default adjustment for Llama-3 we saw a ~8-12% p50 latency increase on hosted/13b canary. Repro steps and a short perf snippet below. Anyone else seeing this?

andre: I saw something similar on the local perf harness. Kernel selector ended up picking a fallback GEMM path around seq_len boundary (1024). Could be kernel mismatch.

maya: perf snapshot:
```
p50: 82ms -> 89ms (+8.5%)
hotspots: attention_forward (30%), rmsnorm (18%), kv_load (12%), cuda_launch_overhead (8%)
kernel chosen: aten_mm_custom (fallback)
```

priya: did you toggle the batching heuristic? We recently changed the dynamic_batch window to 5ms which could change grouping.

maya: yes — with dynamic_batch=on p50=89ms, with dynamic_batch=off p50=83ms. So larger batching window seems to worsen this case.

chen: that points to batch grouping increasing per-request work because KV cache alignment changed. Also the rope_theta scaling tweak can change rotary frequencies which subtly changes memory access patterns and therefore kernel selection. Try forcing the selector to prefer fused_attention_v2 to see if it helps.

andre: can we run selector_trace on the canary? Also check kv cache eviction stats — any spike in evictions would explain extra refill overhead.

maya: running selector_trace now. Also saw a kv_evictions spike in the logs after the change:
```
kv_evictions: 0 -> 14/min
evict_policy: conservative -> latch_on
```

priya: if evictions are up, per-token cost increases due to re-filling cache. I suspect interplay: rope_theta changed token indexing -> less prefix reuse -> more evictions.

chen: short term we should pin rope_theta to the previous default in canary and roll back the change while we investigate. Long term we should update the kernel selector heuristics to account for kv_cache_stride and head_dim alignment.

andre: I prototyped a small selector patch: if head_dim % 64 == 0, prefer int8-fused kernels; also add a cost-model term that penalizes low kv_hit_rate. Quick local runs show p50 improved ~4% with the change.

maya: nice. Can you open a PR with perf numbers (microbench + canary snapshot)? We'll schedule a 24h regression run.

perf-bot: deploy/1713433182 canary started on infra-cluster-3 for commit b3f9c7. tags: rope-theta-rollout

maya: thanks. @andre @priya can you join a short sync at 11:15 to decide rollback threshold? I want to capture a test matrix: seq_lens [128,512,1024], batch_sizes [1,4,8], cache states [warm,cold].

priya: ack — I'll bring the reproducer script and a KV-focused microbench.

andre: adding one note — worth checking RMSNorm fused SiLU path; we saw extra kernel launches for RMSNorm on CUDA12 which increases overhead at small seqs.

chen: also check chat-template/system-token changes: we adjusted early-token tokenization order which changes prefix length and could shift KV addresses. That would be another source of cache shift.

maya: quick summary action items:
- pin rope_theta in canary (maya)
- PR for selector cost-term + alignment heuristic (andre)
- KV microbench + reproducer (priya)
- inspect RMSNorm kernel launches and fused SiLU path (chen)
- run 24h perf sweep and decide rollback threshold based on p50/p95 (team)

chen: I'll upload perf graphs and selector_trace dump to the thread when ready.

andre: uploading a short reproducer gist in a sec — it toggles kernel hints + kv warm/cold.

maya: thanks all. Keeping this thread as the single source for canary results so we can correlate metrics easily. :thumbsup:
